title: People in more individualist cultures are more motivated to make others feel better.
summary: In many Western cultures, trying to make others feel better is considered critical for psychological health and social relationships. However, given that people think about emotions and relationships differently across cultures, the desirability, means, and benefits of making others feel better may also vary by culture. In two multicountry survey studies (Study 1: N = 3,154, 13 countries; Study 2: N = 3,503, 17 countries) and in a daily dairy study (Study 3: N = 243, 2 countries), we assessed motivation and strategies used for influencing others' and one's own emotions. To test whether potential cross-cultural differences in motivation and strategies in emotion regulation are unique to social interactions, we compared cultural differences in making others feel better to making oneself feel better. Across studies, cultural differences in influencing others' emotions were greater than those in influencing one's own emotions. Members of more individualist (vs. collectivist) cultures were more motivated to make others (but not themselves) feel better, were more likely to express care and less likely to encourage others to suppress their emotions or to ruminate. These patterns, in turn, were linked to an index of relationship closeness in an individualist (but not a collectivist) culture. These findings suggest that helping others feel better may not be equally desirable across cultures.

标题：个人主义文化背景下的人们更有动力让他人感觉更好
摘要：在许多西方文化中，尝试让他人感觉更好被视为心理健康和社会关系的关键。然而，由于不同文化背景下人们对情绪和关系的理解存在差异，让他人感觉更好的可取性、手段及其益处也可能因文化而异。通过两项跨国调查研究（研究1：N=3,154，13个国家；研究2：N=3,503，17个国家）以及一项日常日记研究（研究3：N=243，2个国家），我们评估了影响他人及自身情绪的动力和策略。为检验情绪调节动力和策略的潜在跨文化差异是否为社会互动所独有，我们将文化差异与让他人感觉更好和让自己感觉更好进行了比较。跨研究结果表明，影响他人情绪的文化差异大于影响自身情绪的文化差异。在更个人主义（相较于集体主义）的文化中，成员更倾向于让他人（而非自己）感觉更好，更倾向于表达关怀，而较少鼓励他人压抑情绪或陷入反刍思维。这些模式反过来又与个人主义（而非集体主义）文化中关系亲密度的指标相关。这些发现表明，帮助他人感觉更好在不同文化中可能并非同样可取。
关键词：情绪调节；文化差异；个人主义；集体主义；社会互动

title: Anticipatory and theme-specific neural oscillations predict aesthetic evaluation of poetry.
summary: Poetry condenses language into minimal forms, evoking emotion, imagery, and aesthetic judgment, yet the neural basis of such evaluations remains poorly understood. We investigated how the brain evaluates two structurally matched but thematically distinct poetic forms: nature-themed Haiku and emotion-themed Senryu. Participants read poems and rated them across five dimensions-aesthetic appeal, vivid imagery, being moved, originality, and creativity-while EEG was recorded. Using multiclass gradient-boosted tree models with SHapley Additive exPlanations, we predicted evaluative ratings from oscillatory neural features across temporal windows and scalp regions. Models outperformed linear baselines and showed limited cross-theme generalization, indicating content-specific neural encoding. Distinct processing patterns emerged: Senryu showed stronger beta-band contributions, whereas Haiku engaged more distributed multifrequency dynamics. Temporal profiles also differed, with Haiku showing sustained engagement across reading and contemplation phases and Senryu showing earlier evaluative resolution during reading. Prestimulus neural activity contributed to prediction of subsequent evaluations, suggesting a role for anticipatory brain states in aesthetic evaluation. Across poems, evaluative dimensions converged on a dominant shared axis that was reliably predicted from neural features. Together, these findings suggest that aesthetic evaluation of poetry reflects an interaction between anticipatory neural states, content-specific oscillatory dynamics, and dimension-specific processes organized around a shared evaluative axis. This work establishes poetry as a tractable model system for studying how the brain constructs meaning and value from minimal linguistic input.

标题：预期性与主题特异性神经振荡预测诗歌的审美评价

摘要：诗歌将语言浓缩为最小形式，唤起情感、意象和审美判断，然而这类评价的神经基础仍知之甚少。我们研究了大脑如何评估两种结构匹配但主题不同的诗歌形式：以自然为主题的俳句和以情感为主题的川柳。参与者阅读诗歌并在五个维度（审美吸引力、生动意象、感动程度、原创性和创造力）上进行评分，同时记录脑电图。利用多类梯度提升树模型结合SHapley加性解释方法，我们从跨时间窗口和头皮区域的振荡神经特征预测评价得分。模型优于线性基线，并显示出有限的跨主题泛化能力，表明内容特异性神经编码。出现了不同的加工模式：川柳显示出更强的β频段贡献，而俳句则涉及更分散的多频动态。时间特征也不同：俳句在阅读和沉思阶段表现出持续的参与，而川柳在阅读期间显示出更早的评价性解决。刺激前神经活动对后续评价的预测有贡献，表明预期性大脑状态在审美评价中的作用。跨诗歌而言，评价维度汇聚于一个主导的共同轴，该轴可从神经特征可靠预测。总之，这些发现表明诗歌的审美评价反映了预期性神经状态、内容特异性振荡动态以及围绕共同评价轴组织的维度特异性过程之间的相互作用。这项研究确立了诗歌作为研究大脑如何从最小语言输入构建意义和价值的一个可操作模型系统。

关键词：神经振荡；审美评价；诗歌；预期性大脑状态；主题特异性
